name: com.michaelo.oxgkit.cursorsystem
description: The OxGKit is a system tool kit commonly used in game development based on Unity design (all are independent tools).

samples.description: The pre-wired CursorManager prefab. Drop it into the boot scene and author CursorState entries (static/dynamic textures, hotspot, scale, frame rate) in the inspector; the first state is the default.
Demonstrates the Cursors facade: toggling cursor visibility, switching CursorLockMode, changing named cursor states at runtime, and resetting/removing the cursor render.

Agent Skill (SKILL.md) that teaches AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, etc.) how to use the CursorSystem: the Cursors facade, CursorManager states, static/dynamic cursor textures, and visibility/lock control. Copy the skill folder into your agent's skills directory after import (see the sample's README).
